en: Ephesians 5

p.src: 1  Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

en: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
u.src: 1  Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

p.src: 2  Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

en: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
u.src: 2  Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

p.src: 3  But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

en: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
u.src: 3  But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

p.src: 4  nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

en: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
u.src: 4  nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

p.src: 5  Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

en: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
u.src: 5  Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

p.src: 6  Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

en: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
u.src: 6  Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

p.src: 7  Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

en: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
u.src: 7  Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

p.src: 8  For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

en: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
u.src: 8  For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

p.src: 9  for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

en: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
u.src: 9  for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

p.src: 10  proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

en: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
u.src: 10  proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

p.src: 11  Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

en: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
u.src: 11  Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

p.src: 12  For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

en: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
u.src: 12  For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

p.src: 13  But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

en: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
u.src: 13  But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

p.src: 14  Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

en: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
u.src: 14  Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

p.src: 15  Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

en: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
u.src: 15  Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

p.src: 16  redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

en: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
u.src: 16  redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

p.src: 17  Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

en: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
u.src: 17  Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

p.src: 18  Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

en: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
u.src: 18  Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

p.src: 19  speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

en: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
u.src: 19  speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

p.src: 20  giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

en: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
u.src: 20  giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

p.src: 21  subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

en: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
u.src: 21  subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

p.src: 22  Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

en: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
u.src: 22  Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

p.src: 23  For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

en: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
u.src: 23  For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

p.src: 24  But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

en: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
u.src: 24  But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

p.src: 25  Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
u.src: 25  Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

p.src: 26  that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

en: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
u.src: 26  that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

p.src: 27  that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

en: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
u.src: 27  that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

p.src: 28  Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

en: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
u.src: 28  Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

p.src: 29  For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

en: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
u.src: 29  For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

p.src: 30  because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

en: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
u.src: 30  because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

p.src: 31  “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

en: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

p.src: 32  This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

en: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

p.src: 33  Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
